title: Sitar Legend Forever - Easy
description: Sitar Legend Forever - Easy — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Gee Dubya Shrub //TEMP

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 1, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Easy mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Gee Dubya Shrub //TEMP

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to Mutanous Malaise, Level 1, and get a Perfect Score in Sitar Hero on Easy mode. Afterward, return to Gee Dubya Shrub in the Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

If you enjoyed playing Sitar Hero on Easy please feel free to try it again. There's nothing like being able to play a Sitar Hero song with your eyes closed, one hand tied behind your back, and playing using the soft part of your skull! At least that's how I like to play!

The teleporter to play Sitar Hero on Easy is in Mutanous Malaise, Level 1. You've been warned, it is a popular game with the creatures, so you will have to fight your way in. When you have achieved a perfect score, by collecting all the notes that you hit until you have them all, return to me, Gee Dubya Shrub, in Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Turn-in:

It's called Easy for a reason! But, who am I to judgify? I like you just the way you are and it doesn't bother me at all if you want to play it again on Easy....

Objectives:

  • 8 Polkadot Notes ×8

Level range: 33–55
